name: cloudxpl-forge
summary: CloudXPL-Forge (CXF) — Cloud security assessment framework. 508 modules across 20 categories: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, Alibaba, Tencent, IBM, DigitalOcean, OVHcloud, Hetzner, Kubernetes, serverless, storage, multi-cloud, hypervisors (VMware ESXi/vCenter, Hyper-V, KVM/QEMU, Xen/Citrix, Nutanix, Firecracker, Kata, side-channel), VDI escape, PaaS escape, CI/CD runner escape, 100+ CVEs 2019-2026, VM/container/tenant escape, credential and network attack surfaces.
